description: This source file provides utility functions for safely writing, flushing, and syncing data to files or file descriptors, with error handling mechanisms. It appears to be part of a larger codebase related to git, providing abstractions over standard IO operations with additional error checking and environment-driven behavior.

methods.name: void maybe_flush_or_die(FILE * f,const char * desc)
methods.description: Flushes the stream if needed, with error handling; skips for stdout if it is a regular file and flushing is unnecessary.

methods.name: void fprintf_or_die(FILE * f,const char * fmt,...)
methods.description: Prints formatted data to a file, with error handling.

methods.name: int maybe_fsync(int fd)
methods.description: Performs an fsync operation on a file descriptor based on environment settings and sync method.

methods.name: void fsync_or_die(int fd,const char * msg)
methods.description: Performs an fsync and handles errors, terminating on failure.

methods.name: int fsync_component(enum fsync_component component,int fd)
methods.description: Performs fsync operations conditionally based on component flags.

methods.name: void fsync_component_or_die(enum fsync_component component,int fd,const char * msg)
methods.description: Performs fsync with error handling based on component flags.

methods.name: void write_or_die(int fd,const void * buf,size_t count)
methods.description: Writes data to a file descriptor with error handling.

methods.name: void fwrite_or_die(FILE * f,const void * buf,size_t count)
methods.description: Writes data to a FILE stream with error handling.

methods.name: void fflush_or_die(FILE * f)
methods.description: Flushes a FILE stream with error handling.

ctags.name: fsync_component_or_die
ctags.pattern: /^void fsync_component_or_die(enum fsync_component component, int fd, const char *msg)$/

ctags.name: write_or_die
ctags.pattern: /^void write_or_die(int fd, const void *buf, size_t count)$/
